title: Chapter 249 Alliance
content:
Chapter 249 Alliance

Wang Shuo found a dozen lords near Nanshanji.

These two days, they were also dealing with the tax collectors sent by Nanshanji.

Wang Shuo added these lords individually, and then invited them to Wana Village to discuss matters under the pretext of "dealing with the resurrection of the undead", and also revealed that there was a way to deal with the undead army.

Most of these lords showed great interest. As the number one in Changping County, many lords wanted to meet this big guy and learn from him.

Of course, some of them sneered and were unwilling to pay attention to Wang Shuo. In this regard, Wang Shuo could only say that these lords may have missed a great opportunity.

Two days later, lords arrived one after another.

After seeing the tall walls of Wana Village, they were all shocked!

Wang Shuo warmly entertained them in the lord's mansion.

Wine, fruits, roasted whole lamb, and many foods that the lords could not eat at ordinary times were filled on the table, one for each person.

The guests and hosts sat down. The guests who came this time included Liu Zhiming from Gaotang Village, Wang Zhijing from Sangshu Village, Wen Yifan from Meilin Village, Xu Pingwei from Xinxiang Village, and Lin Xin from Luxi Village...

It can be regarded as a well-developed village near Nanshanji.

"Everyone, thank you very much for taking time out of your busy schedule to come to my territory to discuss how to deal with the undead."

"Lord Wang is very polite. Thank you for inviting me. You think highly of us!"

Someone said politely.

"Okay, I won't keep you in suspense. The resurrection of the undead can be said to be the next big thing. I have a prop that can specifically restrain the undead."

Immediately, soldiers handed out the dead spirit beads to the lords who came to the meeting.

"Everyone, this bead is called the Dead Spirit Bead. It can absorb the dead air emitted by the undead, so as to prevent us from being infected by the dead air and being transformed into undead."

"Lord, I am not talented, but I have also been to the ancient battlefield, but I have not been transformed into an undead?" A lord immediately said.

Wang Shuo glanced at this person, who seemed to be Wen Yifan from Meilin Village.

"Lord Wen, please forgive me for being blunt, but the undead in the ancient battlefield and the undead revived this time are fundamentally different. This thing will definitely be able to save your life when the time comes."

At this time, some people were skeptical, and more people had no reaction, which clearly showed that they did not believe it.

Wang Shuo was also very helpless. If you don't believe it, forget it. When the time comes, you will beg me.

"Lord Wang, you asked us to come here just to promote this dead soul bead, didn't you?"

Wang Shuo looked around at everyone, then slowly said: "Of course, it will take some time for the dead souls to revive. Right now we have a more difficult problem, that is the threat of Nanshan Market."

Xu Pingwei from Xinxiang Village said decisively: "Speaking of Nanshan Market, I get angry. Last time Zhuge Kewei came with a large army, he directly took 80,000 gold coins from me. It was really too much!"

"That's right, 60,000 gold coins were taken away from me..."

Everyone complained about their experiences.

Wang Shuo saw that everyone's anger had been ignited, and he also echoed: "To be honest, I was also blackmailed for 10,000 energy crystals last time."

Hearing Wang Shuo say this, everyone was silent.

Even the number one in Changping County was forced to pay "protection fees", what else can they do?

After a while, someone else said: "As far as I know, it seems that there are some lords whose territories have been confiscated and have become refugees from then on."
